description: The absence voice has its own code: when the daemon cannot reach outcome facts at all, retro.list answers the UNAVAILABLE sentence, not a fake empty page and not the refusal voice.

error.message: outcome facts are unavailable in this daemon

data.what: the store backing the outcome facts is not wired — no row exists to read and none can be written
data.means: nothing was read. An empty page would pretend the recorder ran and saw nothing; the daemon says it cannot say instead
data.todo: run the daemon with its store (aeon serve). If this is a fresh install, the fact tables arrive with the store's migrations and the recorder starts with the daemon
